task: Locate the ArXiv Help section and find instructions on how to subscribe to daily listing emails for new submissions in a specific category.
answer: In the arXiv Help section (footer 'Help' link on arxiv.org -> https://info.arxiv.org/help, then 'Subscribe to E-Mail Listings'), the page https://info.arxiv.org/help/subscribe.html explains how to subscribe to daily listing emails of new submissions. To subscribe for a specific category: send a plain ASCII email to the archive's address <archive>@arxiv.org with Subject: 'subscribe Your Full Name'; for archives divided into subject classes (e.g., math, cs, q-bio, q-fin), indicate the categories in the body with 'add <Category>' lines. Example for the Risk Management category (q-fin.RM) in Quantitative Finance - To: q-fin@arxiv.org, Subject: subscribe John Smith, body: add RM. (Use 'del <Category>' to remove a category, and Subject: cancel to unsubscribe.)
